fix: Change DragTargetBuilder<T> to Rc<dyn Fn(&[T], &[T]) -> Widget> and DragTarget::builder to take impl Fn(&[T], &[T]) -> Widget. The From impl then passes slices: builder(&hover.candidates.borrow(), &hover.rejected.borrow()) with no per-rebuild Vec clones. Note this is a public API change and needs a CHANGELOG Breaking entry with migration notes.

The feedback overlay subtree is rebuilt on every pointer move during a drag (DragSourceBinding::update bumps revision whenever position changes). Each rebuild allocates a Vec for Stack::new(vec![placed]), clones the feedback child and the portal child, and reconstructs the Positioned/IgnorePointer nodes. Keep the feedback position out of the build path (for example a shared Cell/ offset read by the positioned layer, or a layout-time offset), so only the overlay's layout is refreshed per move, and build the Stack once per drag start.
